Sildar Hallwinter.style: A noble, honorable human knight. Steady and sincere, a little weary from hard travel, speaking with quiet resolve.

Gundren Rockseeker.style: A gruff, excitable dwarf prospector with a rough burr. Proud and brusque, thrilled about treasure.

Toblen Stonehill.style: A warm, friendly innkeeper. Cheerful and hospitable, but worried about the town underneath the welcome.

Elmar Barthen.style: An old, tidy shopkeeper in his seventies. Polite, patient and a little fussy, with a thin, creaky, aged voice that wavers slightly and slows down to think.

Sister Garaele.style: A calm elven priestess and secret Harper. Soft, graceful and measured, with a hint of mystery.

Halia Thornton.style: A brisk, ambitious businesswoman. Polished, calculating and cool, every sentence a negotiation.

Iarno Glasstaff.style: A smug, arrogant wizard who thinks he is the cleverest person in the room. Silky, contemptuous and controlled.

Klarg.style: A brutish bugbear boss. Very deep and guttural, loud and bullying, speaking in broken short sentences.

Yeemik.style: A scheming goblin leader. Raspy, high and fast, nervous, sneaky and eager to make a deal.

Nezznar.style: A cold, patient drow spellcaster known as the Black Spider. Quiet, silky and venomous, never raising his voice.

Agatha.style: A haunting banshee. Whispering, mournful and echoing, with long eerie pauses and sudden sharpness.

Reidoth.style: A very old, solitary druid. Slow, gravelly and weathered, a gentle rasp and a quaver of age, with the calm of someone who prefers trees to people.
